po_script.message: Keep the pre-selection, and keep the single 'Pay' button as the explicit action: the customer always confirms the order with the pre-selected method visibly shown, and can change it with one tap. That removes the selection step but never charges without one explicit customer action. Add a criterion: the pre-selected method and total are visible on the Pay button.
